name: lead-quality-closed-out-of-area
about: LR4: one campaign's leads are mostly closed as out of area — the reason a recruiter gave, per campaign, which no other part of the sheet can show. The other campaign has no such close.

output.headline: November 3, 2026: 2 campaigns spent $284.25, pulled 14,600 impressions, 203 clicks, and 7 leads at $40.61 per lead.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet led the day: $184.50 spend, 9,120 impressions, 141 clicks at 1.5%, and 6 leads at $30.75 each. Dedicated night runs spent $99.75 for 5,480 impressions, 62 clicks at 1.1%, and 1 lead at $99.75.
Month to date in November 2026, Meta has taken $612.30 of budget with 28 days left in the month.
The 2026-10-26 cohort is too young to judge: 12 leads, 9 contacted, 3 made applicants, 1 applied, and none hired yet.

The 2026-09-28 mature cohort shows 40 leads, 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 made applicants (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost after conversion (22.5%). The 2026-09-21 cohort had 38 leads, 33 contacted (86.8%), 17 made applicants (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 lost after conversion (21.1%).

Regional Class A — Joliet had 11 leads closed as out of area over the last 14 days — a figure worth attention given 24 total leads in that window. 3 missed a hard requirement (12.5% of leads), and the wrong-number share of leads called was 10.5%.

Dedicated night runs had a median first-call time of 42 minutes over the last 14 days, notably slower than Regional Class A — Joliet's 11 minutes. 1 lead missed a hard requirement (11.1% of leads); wrong numbers were 12.5% of leads called.
